top_signals.title: CEA Chairman: Inflation coming down sufficiently fast
top_signals.summary: Chris Phelan CEA Chairman, sees inflation clearly easing and thinks it's doing so quickly enough. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Using Decision Science in Investing | Masters in Business with Omar Aguilar
top_signals.summary: Barry speaks with Omar Aguilar, CEO and CIO of Schwab Asset Management. They discuss his time at Financial Engines, where he worked under Nobel laureate William Sharpe before joining Schwab Asset Management in 2011. They discuss how his doctorate in decision sciences helps him build trust with clients and push them toward their goals. They also discuss how he built Schwab Asset Management to over a trillion dollars and how he is using his background to help navigate his clients through the current state of the markets. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Cerebras stock hits post-IPO low, tumbling 20% for the week on Nvidia pressure and lockup expiration
top_signals.summary: Cerebras shares hit an all-time low due to pressure from chip giant Nvidia, plus a post-lockup selloff.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
